# Copilot instructions

Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) at the repository root before you change anything. It is the single
source of truth for this repository: the rules, the repository map, the build and test commands, the
never-commit list and the commit style. Do not work from memory of what an emulator repository
usually looks like.

- Pick a task from the issues labelled `agent-ready` (without `needs-triage`), or start from
  [docs/AI-QUICKSTART.md](../docs/AI-QUICKSTART.md).
- Disclose the AI's part with an `Assisted-by:` trailer ([docs/AI_POLICY.md](../docs/AI_POLICY.md)).
